takeaways.en: Write explicit measures (Total Sales = SUM(Sales[Amount])) instead of relying on implicit summarisation of columns.
takeaways.zh: 编写显式度量值（Total Sales = SUM(Sales[Amount])），不要依赖列的隐式汇总。

takeaways.en: COUNT counts non-blank values in a column; COUNTROWS counts rows of a table; DISTINCTCOUNT counts different values.
takeaways.zh: COUNT 计算列中的非空值；COUNTROWS 计算表的行数；DISTINCTCOUNT 计算不同值的数量。

takeaways.en: Build measures on measures: Margin % = DIVIDE([Margin], [Total Sales]).
takeaways.zh: 用度量值构建度量值：Margin % = DIVIDE([Margin], [Total Sales])。

html.en: Dragging a numeric column into a visual creates an implicit measure (the Σ sum). It works, but you cannot reuse it, it does not work with calculation groups, and other tools (Excel, Copilot) see less meaning. Good models use explicit measures written in DAX and hide the raw numeric columns.
html.zh: 把数值列拖进视觉对象会产生隐式度量值（Σ 求和）。它能用，但无法重用、不支持计算组，其他工具（Excel、Copilot）也难以理解。好的模型用 DAX 编写显式度量值，并隐藏原始数值列。

blocks.text:
Total Sales    = SUM ( Sales[Amount] )
Order Count    = DISTINCTCOUNT ( Sales[OrderID] )
Sales Lines    = COUNTROWS ( Sales )
Average Price  = AVERAGE ( Sales[Unit Price] )
Margin         = [Total Sales] - [Total Cost]
Margin %       = DIVIDE ( [Margin], [Total Sales] )

rows.en: The usual aggregations of one column

rows.zh: 任何类型的非空值数量

rows.en: a / b, returning BLANK (or a value you give) instead of an error when b is 0
rows.zh: a / b；当 b 为 0 时返回 BLANK（或你指定的值），而不是错误

html.en: The exam lists "basic statistical functions": AVERAGE, MEDIAN, MIN/MAX, STDEV.S/STDEV.P (sample vs population standard deviation), VAR.S/VAR.P, PERCENTILE.INC, and RANKX for ranking. Their X versions (AVERAGEX, MEDIANX…) iterate over a table first.
html.zh: 考试列出了「基本统计函数」：AVERAGE、MEDIAN、MIN/MAX、STDEV.S/STDEV.P（样本与总体标准差）、VAR.S/VAR.P、PERCENTILE.INC，以及用于排名的 RANKX。它们的 X 版本（AVERAGEX、MEDIANX……）会先遍历一张表。

q.en: Sales has one row per order line. Which measure counts the number of orders?
q.zh: Sales 表每个订单明细一行。哪个度量值能计算订单数量？

why.zh: 这计算的是订单明细行数。

why.en: COUNT counts every non-blank line, duplicates included.
why.zh: COUNT 会计算每一个非空行，包括重复的。

why.en: Right: each order appears on several lines.
why.zh: 对：每个订单会出现在多行明细中。

q.zh: 为什么用 DIVIDE([A], [B]) 而不是 [A] / [B]？

html.en: It handles division by zero safely, returning BLANK or an alternate result
html.zh: 它能安全地处理除以零，返回 BLANK 或替代结果

heading.zh: 行上下文与筛选上下文

takeaways.en: Filter context is the set of filters on a calculation: slicers, visual axes, filters and RLS.
takeaways.zh: 筛选上下文是计算所受的筛选条件：切片器、视觉对象的轴、筛选器和 RLS。

takeaways.en: Row context is "the current row", which exists in calculated columns and in iterators such as SUMX.
takeaways.zh: 行上下文是「当前行」，存在于计算列和 SUMX 等迭代器中。

takeaways.en: Row context does not filter by itself; CALCULATE (or calling a measure) turns it into filter context — context transition.
takeaways.zh: 行上下文本身不会筛选；CALCULATE（或调用度量值）会把它变成筛选上下文——这叫上下文转换。

html.en: Every DAX result depends on its evaluation context. Understanding the two kinds of context is the key to reading any DAX formula.
html.zh: 每个 DAX 结果都取决于它的计算上下文。理解两种上下文，是读懂任何 DAX 公式的关键。

rows.en: Visual rows/columns, slicers, filter pane, cross-filtering, RLS, CALCULATE
rows.zh: 视觉对象的行/列、切片器、筛选器窗格、交叉筛选、RLS、CALCULATE

rows.en: Which rows of each table are visible
Which single row is being evaluated
No — use RELATED to read the one side
rows.zh: 不会——用 RELATED 读取「一」端的值

html.en: Example: in a matrix with Product[Category] on rows, the cell for "Bikes" evaluates [Total Sales] with the filter context Category = Bikes. The same measure in the total row has no Category filter.
html.zh: 例子：在行是 Product[Category] 的矩阵中，「Bikes」单元格以筛选上下文 Category = Bikes 计算 [Total Sales]。同一个度量值在总计行就没有 Category 筛选。

html.en: In a calculated column on Customer, SUM(Sales[Amount]) returns the grand total on every row: the row context of Customer does not filter Sales. Wrapping it in CALCULATE, or referencing a measure (which has an implicit CALCULATE), converts the current row into a filter: now each customer gets their own sales.
html.zh: 在 Customer 表的计算列中，SUM(Sales[Amount]) 在每一行都返回总计：Customer 的行上下文不会筛选 Sales。用 CALCULATE 包起来，或引用一个度量值（度量值自带隐式 CALCULATE），就会把当前行转换成筛选：这样每个客户都得到自己的销售额。

blocks.text:
-- Calculated columns on the Customer table
Wrong     = SUM ( Sales[Amount] )                  -- same grand total on every row
Right     = CALCULATE ( SUM ( Sales[Amount] ) )    -- this customer's sales
Also Right = [Total Sales]                          -- a measure triggers context transition

q.en: A calculated column on Customer uses SUM(Sales[Amount]) and shows the same value on every row. Why?
q.zh: Customer 表上的计算列使用 SUM(Sales[Amount])，每一行都显示相同的值。为什么？

html.en: The column needs a data category

html.zh: SUM 只能用在度量值中

html.en: Row context does not filter related tables without context transition
html.zh: 没有上下文转换时，行上下文不会筛选相关的表

why.en: Right: wrap it in CALCULATE or use a measure.
why.zh: 对：用 CALCULATE 包起来，或改用度量值。

takeaways.en: CALCULATE(expression, filters…) evaluates an expression in a modified filter context.
takeaways.zh: CALCULATE(表达式, 筛选条件…) 在修改后的筛选上下文中计算表达式。

takeaways.en: A filter argument on a column replaces the existing filter on that column; KEEPFILTERS intersects instead.
takeaways.zh: 对某列的筛选参数会取代该列现有的筛选；KEEPFILTERS 则改为取交集。

takeaways.en: ALL / REMOVEFILTERS remove filters (for % of total); ALLEXCEPT keeps only some; ALLSELECTED respects the user's selections.
takeaways.zh: ALL / REMOVEFILTERS 移除筛选（用于占总计百分比）；ALLEXCEPT 只保留部分筛选；ALLSELECTED 会尊重用户的选择。

html.en: CALCULATE is the most important function in DAX. It is the only way (with CALCULATETABLE) to change the filter context of a calculation.
html.zh: CALCULATE 是 DAX 中最重要的函数。它（以及 CALCULATETABLE）是改变计算的筛选上下文的唯一方法。

blocks.text:
Red Sales        = CALCULATE ( [Total Sales], Product[Colour] = "Red" )
Red Sales (kept) = CALCULATE ( [Total Sales], KEEPFILTERS ( Product[Colour] = "Red" ) )
All Sales        = CALCULATE ( [Total Sales], REMOVEFILTERS ( Product ) )
% of All Products = DIVIDE ( [Total Sales], [All Sales] )
% of Category    = DIVIDE ( [Total Sales],
                       CALCULATE ( [Total Sales], ALLEXCEPT ( Product, Product[Category] ) ) )
% of Selection   = DIVIDE ( [Total Sales], CALCULATE ( [Total Sales], ALLSELECTED ( Product ) ) )
Big Orders       = CALCULATE ( [Total Sales], FILTER ( Sales, Sales[Amount] > 1000 ) )

rows.en: Replace any filter on that column with this one
rows.zh: 以此筛选取代该列上的任何筛选

rows.en: Add the filter on top of existing ones (intersection)
rows.zh: 在现有筛选之上再加这个筛选（交集）

rows.en: Remove filters — the grand total denominator
Remove all filters on the table except the listed columns
rows.zh: 移除表上所有筛选，只保留列出的列

rows.en: Remove filters from the visual but keep slicer and filter-pane selections
rows.zh: 移除视觉对象内的筛选，但保留切片器和筛选器窗格的选择

rows.en: Change filter direction for this calculation
rows.zh: 为这个计算改变筛选方向

rows.en: Row-by-row filter; needed for conditions on measures or several columns
rows.zh: 逐行筛选；条件涉及度量值或多个列时需要

html.en: "% of grand total that does not change when a user selects a slicer" → ALL/REMOVEFILTERS. "% of the total of what the user selected" → ALLSELECTED.
html.zh: 「不随用户选择切片器而改变的总计百分比」→ ALL/REMOVEFILTERS。「占用户所选范围合计的百分比」→ ALLSELECTED。

q.en: In a matrix by Product, you need each product's share of sales across all products. Which denominator is right?
q.zh: 在按 Product 分行的矩阵中，你需要每个产品占所有产品销售额的比例。哪个分母正确？

why.en: Still evaluated within the row's product filter.
why.zh: 仍在行的产品筛选范围内计算。

why.en: Right: the product filter from the row is removed.
why.zh: 对：移除了来自行的产品筛选。

why.en: That still respects the row's product filter.
why.zh: 这仍然受行的产品筛选影响。

q.en: A matrix has Colour on rows. Measure: CALCULATE([Total Sales], Product[Colour] = "Red"). What does the Blue row show?
q.zh: 矩阵的行是 Colour。度量值：CALCULATE([Total Sales], Product[Colour] = "Red")。Blue 那一行显示什么？

html.en: Red sales — the filter argument replaces the row's Colour filter
html.zh: 红色的销售额——筛选参数取代了行的 Colour 筛选

why.en: Right: use KEEPFILTERS to get blank for non-red rows.
why.zh: 对：若要让非红色行显示空白，使用 KEEPFILTERS。

heading.zh: 迭代器、变量和常用函数

takeaways.en: Iterators (SUMX, AVERAGEX, MAXX, RANKX, FILTER) evaluate an expression row by row over a table, then aggregate.
takeaways.zh: 迭代器（SUMX、AVERAGEX、MAXX、RANKX、FILTER）逐行遍历一张表计算表达式，然后再聚合。

takeaways.en: Variables (VAR … RETURN) make measures readable and avoid calculating the same thing twice.
takeaways.zh: 变量（VAR … RETURN）让度量值更易读，并避免重复计算同一个东西。

takeaways.en: SELECTEDVALUE, HASONEVALUE, SWITCH(TRUE()) and BLANK handling are everyday tools.
takeaways.zh: SELECTEDVALUE、HASONEVALUE、SWITCH(TRUE()) 和 BLANK 处理是日常工具。

html.en: SUM can only add up a column. When you need to multiply first and add after — quantity × price on each line — use an iterator.
html.zh: SUM 只能加总一列。当你需要先相乘再相加——每一行的数量 × 单价——就要用迭代器。

blocks.text:
Revenue = SUMX ( Sales, Sales[Quantity] * Sales[Unit Price] )

Avg Sales per Customer = AVERAGEX ( VALUES ( Customer[CustomerID] ), [Total Sales] )

Product Rank = RANKX ( ALL ( Product[Name] ), [Total Sales], , DESC, DENSE )

Sales vs Target % =
VAR Actual = [Total Sales]
VAR Target = [Sales Target]
RETURN
    IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( Target ), DIVIDE ( Actual - Target, Target ) )

Selected Region = SELECTEDVALUE ( Store[Region], "Several regions" )

Size Band =
SWITCH ( TRUE (),
    [Total Sales] >= 1000000, "Large",
    [Total Sales] >= 100000,  "Medium",
    "Small" )

rows.zh: 逐行计算表达式，再聚合

rows.en: Rank of the current item; use ALL() so it ranks against every item
rows.zh: 当前项目的排名；用 ALL() 才会与所有项目比较

rows.en: Store an intermediate result; evaluated once in the context where it is defined
rows.zh: 保存中间结果；在定义处的上下文中只计算一次

rows.en: The single selected value, or alt if zero or several
rows.zh: 唯一选中的值；若没有或有多个则返回替代值

rows.en: TRUE when exactly one value is in context — hide totals with it
rows.zh: 上下文中恰好只有一个值时为 TRUE——可用来隐藏总计

rows.en: From the many side, read a column on the one side (row context)
rows.zh: 在「多」端读取「一」端的列（行上下文）

q.en: Sales has Quantity and Unit Price but no amount column. Which measure gives total revenue correctly?
q.zh: Sales 有 Quantity 和 Unit Price，但没有金额列。哪个度量值能正确算出总收入？

why.en: Right: multiply on each row, then sum.
Multiplying two totals is not the sum of the products.
why.zh: 两个合计相乘并不等于各行乘积的总和。

q.en: A card must show the selected region's name, or "All regions" when none or several are selected. Which function?
q.zh: 卡片要显示所选区域的名称；没选或选了多个时显示「All regions」。用哪个函数？

why.en: Returns a table; errors if more than one value in a card.
why.zh: 返回的是表；在卡片中有多个值时会出错。

why.en: Returns a value even when several are selected.
why.zh: 即使选了多个，也会返回一个值。
